Original dataset titles, observed years and URLs accompany source series. Only source-reported all-age/all-type totals enter territory curves; age and serogroup components remain separate. TB notification-location observations through 2018 and residence-location observations from 2019 have separate definitions: the representative curve may use only the residence series, with older data retained in source details. Missing territory-years are unknown. Territory observations are not added to France national totals. No publisher endorsement is implied.
